heroHeadline: Ethiopian Federal Forces Take Mekelle as TPLF Says It Withdrew Temporarily
heroSubtitle: TPLF calls its pullout from Tigray's capital tactical and vows to keep fighting; fighting has spread to Afar and Amhara and Ethiopia-Eritrea relations are severed. Independent verification remains limited.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
